_about: Oria insights panels (includes/facet-insights.php): figures Oria Haven worked out from details checked on each venue's own website or the booking page it links to. Keyed by facet URL slug. 'checked' is the date of the check; panels older than 183 days are hidden, so re-check and bump the date. 'snapshot' replaces the hero's 'Typical published price' on that page. Never fill a figure from a listing's generic price_from. Source research for the sauna panels: D:/OriaHaven/drafts/saunas/sauna-prices-checked-2026-10-07.json.

_method.typical: Median of single-person, sauna-only prices for that session length, one price per venue. Pods and multi-therapy rooms (Element, Active Wellness) and sauna-plus-ice-bath bundles excluded.
_method.cheapest_for_two: Lowest published two-person price for the shortest common session.
_method.river: North or south of the Swan River by the venue's suburb.
_method.private: Venues whose own site says sessions are private or the cabin is your own; 'not stated' is not counted either way.
_method.lengths: Count of venues offering each session length, out of venues with a working website.
_method.amenities: Showers, Sunday hours and towels from venues' own sites or the booking page they link to (D:/OriaHaven/drafts/saunas/sauna-amenities-checked-2026-10-07.json). Excluded where the source contradicts itself or only mentions the feature for another service: Merse's showers are a circuit feature; Recovery Haus and The Neighbourhood Sauna give conflicting towel answers; Rhema's and Salt Float's showers are for float rooms only.

infrared-sauna.basis: prices published by 25 Perth infrared sauna venues on their own websites

items.label: Typical 30-minute session
items.note: Median of the 10 venues publishing a single 30-minute price. Range $25–$70.

items.label: Typical 45-minute session
items.note: Median of 7 venues. Range $35–$55.

items.label: Cheapest published
items.note: Zen Zone in Beldon and Rhema Wellness Studio in Cockburn Central.

items.label: Most common session length
items.note: Offered by 13 of 25 venues; 45 and 60 minutes by 9 each.

items.label: Cheapest for two
items.note: Zen Zone. Elsewhere a second person adds $10–$30 rather than doubling the price.

items.label: Cheapest north of the river
items.note: Zen Zone, Beldon, for 30 minutes. Next: Recovery Lab, Jolimont, $30.

items.label: Cheapest south of the river
items.note: Rhema Wellness Studio, Cockburn Central, for 30 minutes. Next: Salt Float Studio, South Perth, $30.

items.label: Private cabins
items.note: Say in writing that sessions are private. None say shared; the rest don't state it.

items.label: Open on Sundays
items.note: Of 23 venues checked; three are closed Sundays and five don't publish their hours. Earliest start: Zen Zone, 5am.

items.label: Showers mentioned
items.note: The Neighbourhood Sauna (South Terrace), Palm Beach Wellness, Locked In Recovery, Ultimate Recovery Lounge, Recovery Lab and Modern Ritual say guests can shower.

items.label: Towels
items.note: Merse, Zen Zone and Recovery Lab charge $4.95–$5; Mindbody Lounge, Palm Beach Wellness and Ultimate Recovery Lounge supply them. Most don't say.

items.label: Cheapest hour
items.note: Alchemy Saunas, East Perth (shared, ice and magnesium pools included), and Sauna & Ice Bath Booragoon (private barrel sauna, sauna only).

items.label: Full bathhouse circuit

items.label: Most common session length

items.label: Weekly memberships from
items.note: Löyly Recovery, Stirling, for one communal session a week. RecWell, Wangara: $49 for two.

saunas.basis: prices published by 30 Perth sauna venues on their own websites

items.label: Typical infrared session
items.note: Median of 10 venues publishing a single 30-minute price.

items.label: Cheapest infrared
items.note: Zen Zone, Beldon, and Rhema Wellness Studio, Cockburn Central.

items.label: Cheapest traditional
items.note: Sauna & Ice Bath Booragoon, private barrel sauna. An hour's shared drop-in at Alchemy Saunas, East Perth, is $35.

items.label: Private or shared
items.note: 15 of 25 infrared venues say sessions are private; three of the five sauna houses checked run shared sessions.

items.label: Sauna and ice bath together
items.note: Zen Zone and Sauna & Ice Bath Booragoon. Most combined sessions are $40–$80.

items.label: Open on Sundays
items.note: Of 28 infrared and traditional venues checked; four are closed Sundays and five don't publish their hours.

reformer.basis: prices published by 25 Perth reformer Pilates studios on their own websites

items.label: Typical casual class
items.note: Median of the 16 studios publishing a drop-in price. Range $26–$70; the dearest are physio-led clinical classes.

items.label: Cheapest casual class
items.note: The Pilates Warehouse, Joondalup. South of the river: The Studio Perth, East Victoria Park, $34.

items.label: Typical intro offer
items.note: Median of 14 new-client offers, usually two to four weeks of classes. Range $55–$190.

items.label: Cheapest 10-class pack
items.note: The Pilates Warehouse — $24 a class. Most packs work out at $26–$33 a class.

items.label: One class a week
items.note: Median of nine one-class-a-week plans. Several need a 12-week or three-month minimum.

items.label: Private session
items.note: Published by eight studios; median about $100.

items.label: Physio-led studios
items.note: Run by physiotherapists; clinical Pilates usually starts with a one-to-one assessment.

acupuncture.basis: fees published by 14 Perth acupuncture clinics on their own websites or booking pages

items.label: Typical first visit
items.note: Median initial consultation and treatment at the 8 clinics publishing a fee. Range $95–$200.

items.label: Typical follow-up
items.note: Median of 8 clinics. Range $75–$120.

items.label: Cheapest first visit
items.note: Baolin Acupuncture & Chinese Medicine Centre, Perth CBD, with $75 follow-ups. South of the river: Nature's Chinese Medicine & Acupuncture, Belmont, $105.

items.label: Specialist clinics
items.note: First-visit range at the six clinics that do acupuncture and Chinese medicine only; multi-discipline clinics charge up to $200.

items.label: Fees published
items.note: The other six quote on enquiry or inside a booking app.

items.label: Health fund rebates
items.note: One clinic publishes a typical rebate of $20–$55 a treatment; it depends on your fund and level of cover.

float-therapy.basis: prices published by seven Perth float centres on their own websites (checked 3–7 October 2026)

items.note: Median of seven float centres. Range $70–$89.

items.note: Swan Valley Retreat, Henley Brook, which also sells 90 minutes for $99.
